projects.name: Logic Looper
projects.description: A daily puzzle platform built client-first for speed and offline resilience. Fixed a scoring bug (startTimeRef never initializing, causing scores to compute as zero), rewrote puzzle generators to be seed-driven for deterministic daily puzzles, replaced hardcoded URLs with environment variables, moved Firebase credentials out of source, added a proper Redux Provider, and cleaned out 13 dead files.
projects.interview_note: Flagged as a key interview differentiator - has real architecture decisions and a concrete before/after bug fix story to tell under pressure.

projects.name: DriveClone
projects.tagline: Google Drive clone with a native MCP server for AI agents
projects.description: A full MERN Google Drive clone with JWT auth, Cloudinary-backed file storage, and a native MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the drive directly. Backend deployed on Render, frontend on Vercel. Resolved a peer dependency conflict between cloudinary@2.x and multer-storage-cloudinary@4.x using --legacy-peer-deps.
projects.interview_note: Key interview differentiator - demonstrates AI engineering layer (MCP server) beyond a standard MERN CRUD app.
